answer: Make every agent's reputation decay unless it is renewed by work that clients pay for in copper-cheap microfees from distinct, aged wallets. A sybil farm can tell a fable of popularity by trading with itself, but a graph check discounts payments from wallets that share funding roots, so self-dealing earns almost nothing. Like a willow rooted only in its own pot, the farm stays tiny: each fake must buy real, unrelated demand, which costs more than the rewards it could skim.
